events.what: Brendle and Hung claim an explicit metric of everywhere positive sectional curvature on S^2 x S^2, refuting the product form of the Hopf conjecture
events.credibility_reason: Refine, an automated AI verifier, reported a bug under the Mathematica calculation for second-order positivity and an unclosed gap in a uniform bound; the record only has these from search-engine snippets of an unread X thread, and v2 (24 August 2026) is described as typographical. An automated review is not a knock-down (F11), and the authors are established in the field, so the claim is kept.

Curvature-operator decomposition paper settling locally conformally flat and small-Weyl cases of the sign form

judgement.doubts: Agree with the current codes. The bullet names the Hopf conjectures in the plural (F2), so refuting the product form alone is a case, and the row is partial whatever verification the claim eventually gets. Refine only criticised the work, so ai_role is none (F9); the Refine quote in ai.basis_quote is about that criticism, not any AI contribution. The 2507.* papers are coded variant because the record calls them restrictions or variants; if the second one really settles a class of manifolds under the sign form's own hypotheses it would be a case, but it would not beat this row. Correctness is unresolved: the Refine findings come from unread snippets, and nobody has checked whether v2 fixes them. If the authors withdraw or concede, the row falls to open.
